subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Know Your Customer Basics
description: A fast breakdown of Know Your Customer Basics for builders.

hook.text: A man opens a bank account with a fake passport and deposits millions. Nobody checks. That's what KYC prevents.

buildup.text: KYC requires financial institutions to verify the identity of every customer before opening an account.

discovery.text: Standard KYC involves ID verification, address checks, and screening against sanctions and watchlists.

twist.text: KYC creates friction that pushes some legitimate customers to unregulated services with no checks at all.

climax.text: KYC is the first line of defense. It's imperfect but without it, banks become open doors for criminals.

punchline.text: Check the ID. Check the watchlist. That's KYC.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of KYC?
options: Verify customer identity before opening accounts
Keep your cash secure in vaults
